name: SparkRx
short_description: Digital therapeutic for adolescents and young adults ages 13-22 with depression symptoms, delivering self-guided CBT and behavioral activation through a mobile app.
long_description: SparkRx is the first digital therapeutic designed specifically for adolescents and young adults ages 13-22 with symptoms of depression. Developed by Limbix (acquired by Big Health in 2023), the app delivers a multi-week program based on cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT) and behavioral activation protocols. The self-guided treatment teaches skills including mood tracking, behavioral activation, problem solving, and mindfulness, designed to complement treatment by a clinician. Clinical trials demonstrated a 21% remission rate compared to 4% for control groups, with treatment response rates of 29% versus 16%. Big Health acquired Limbix to expand their evidence-based digital therapeutics into adolescent mental health.
one_liner: Digital therapeutic for teen and young adult depression
best_for: and school-based mental health providers treating teens and young adults ages 13-22 with depression symptoms
not_for: Patients with severe depression requiring hospitalization or those outside the 13-22 age range

compliance.fda_clearance_type: Not FDA cleared; marketed under COVID-19 enforcement policy

faqs.a: SparkRx is a digital therapeutic designed for adolescents and young adults ages 13-22 with symptoms of depression, delivering self-guided CBT and behavioral activation through a mobile app.
SparkRx is not FDA cleared but was made available under the FDA's COVID-19 enforcement policy for psychiatric digital health devices. Big Health acquired Limbix, the creator of SparkRx, in 2023.
Clinical trials showed a 21% remission rate compared to 4% for control groups, with treatment response rates of 29% versus 16% for SparkRx users.
Big Health, the company behind SleepioRx and DaylightRx, acquired Limbix in 2023 to expand into adolescent mental health.
